stories.title: Branch line disrupted due to multiple signal issues
stories.summary: National Rail says services on the East Suffolk line will be replaced by buses.

stories.title: UK security criticised after USAF planes removed
stories.summary: A former military intelligence officer says incidents at RAF bases used by the US are "embarrassing".

stories.title: Plea for vets to keep animal mural painted in 1985
stories.summary: The owners of the vet surgery say they will be covering up the artwork but it will be preserved.

stories.title: A14 reopens after lorry fire
stories.summary: The busy road is partially closed until the early hours of Friday morning following the fire.

stories.title: Ex-pupils back at their school as trainee teachers
stories.summary: Two women help children in the same classrooms where they felt inspired to become teachers.

stories.title: HGV driver 'distracted' by game during fatal crash
stories.summary: Christopher Cooke has been convicted of dangerous driving and jailed for 11 years after the 2023 crash.

stories.title: Threat was to US base, not town, says MP
stories.summary: A Suffolk MP says the government tells him the threat was not imminent.

stories.title: DJ Tim Westwood denies two more sexual offences
stories.summary: His latest pleas of not guilty mean he now denies a total of 17 charges concerning allegations from 1983 to 2016.

stories.title: Cuts to child health services after council vote
stories.summary: The Labour MP for Ipswich says the decision brings "another dark day for children and families".

stories.title: Pride as war memorials are granted listed status
stories.summary: The monuments at Barrack Square, Martlesham Heath, are being given Grade II listed status.

stories.title: Nurse threatened to kill colleague, report finds
stories.summary: Rupesh Patel said he would "hunt down" and "kill" his whole family, a panel says.

stories.title: Contract agreed for asylum camp at former RAF base
stories.summary: The Home Office awards a £3.4m deal to design the controversial site, ahead of any final decision.
